annotations.target_phrase: The superior, the very reverend John Conmee S.J. reset his smooth watch in his pocket
annotations.annotation_text: Opening of Episode 10 (Wandering Rocks). 3:00 PM. Father John Conmee, S.J., former rector of Clongowes Wood College, begins his afternoon walk through the north side of Dublin. The episode is structured in 19 synchronous mini-scenes weaving across the civic labyrinth of Dublin.
sources: Gilbert, Stuart. James Joyce's Ulysses. Faber, 1930.
Gifford, Don, and Robert J. Seidman. Ulysses Annotated. UC Press, 1988, p. 254.

annotations.annotation_text: Joyce's Jesuit boarding school in County Kildare, prominently featured in A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man. Conmee represents the spiritual authority of Rome in Ireland alongside the Viceroy's British imperial power.
sources: Joyce, James. A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man. 1916.
Ellmann, Richard. James Joyce. Oxford UP, 1982.
